outcome: surgical indices (e.g., bleeding, time for beta-hCG to fall to negative)
complication incidence (postoperative infection, liver function impairment)
cohort: 98 pregnant women with cesarean scar pregnancy.
finding: Mifepristone pretreatment before combined laparoscopic treatment for cesarean scar pregnancy promoted postoperative recovery, reduced stress response, improved hemodynamics, regulated sex hormone levels, and promoted early menstrual recovery.
